title: biomes.fire/1
description: data/biomes/fire.json: fires in the forests (docs/world/forest-fire.md; WorldFire). Version field: schema. Policy: every key required, objects closed except keys starting with an underscore. Order checks and biome names are WorldFire's own load and fire_check.

enabled.description: Fires in the forests on or off; off, nothing in WorldFire runs and the trees are as they were.

bandLo.description: Trees from this share of a blast's radius out may catch (inside 0.7 they are felled).

bandHi.description: Up to this share (above bandLo: WorldFire's load).

chance.description: The chance, times the ground's flammability.

ticks.description: Ticks a tree burns before it is dead and charred.

spreadRadius.description: A burning tree may light a tree within this many units.

spread.description: The chance a second at point-blank, falling with distance, times the flammability.

every.description: Spread is tried every this many ticks.

maxBurning.description: At most this many trees burn at once.

quenchDepth.description: Water deeper than this at a tree's column puts it out.

flammable.description: By biome name (the fine name on a gen 2 planet); a biome not listed does not burn. Names are checked by WorldFire's load.
